items.title: Pete Levin interviewed by Monk Rowe, Danbury, Connecticut, November 20, 2001
items.q: Just to be on stage with him and doing his music is great.

ctx.x: Of the pop people that you’ve worked with, do any of them stand out as particularly memorable? Enjoyable?

Oh sure. They’re all enjoyable — Paul Simon is one of my favorite composers. That says a lot. Just to be on stage with him and doing his music is great. Annie Lennox who I did more recently, Annie is a wonderful singer and I like her music a lot. Performing it is a restricted situation. Annie works out carefully what it is she wants to do and she is very good at that so the performance — here’s the record—
